patch.summary: Otter.ai cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Otter.ai pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Basic. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Otter.ai cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Otter.ai against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Basic until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Basic, Pro, Business, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, projects, GPTs, and memory) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Minute and per-conversation caps on Free/Pro burn down in a busy meeting week. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 5
